messages:
alex: Hey sec team — need one-time console sudo for ~30m to triage a stuck inference job in `prod-inference` namespace. Pods keep restarting due to KV cache OOMs, want to exec and grab /var/log/infer.log and metrics. Incident INC-2026-1223. I will not touch databases or secrets. Will record session and upload logs to s3://redwood-logs/INC-2026-1223/. Can someone approve or advise fastest path? :pray:

maria: @alex thanks — can you confirm the exact pod names, the minimal actions you need (exec+logs only?), and the start window? we need an audit trail and RBAC scope. Also paste the runbook link.

alex: Pod names: `infer-worker-0`, `infer-worker-1` (both in prod-inference). Actions: `kubectl exec -c runtime -- tar czf /tmp/logs.tar /var/log/infer.log && kubectl cp` and `kubectl logs --previous` if available. Start window: 14:30-15:00 UTC (now +10m). Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/inference-kv-triage. Will enable terminal recording and share the recording URL in the ticket.

cheng: Ok — thanks for details. Please open a JIT access request (https://admin.redwood/jit) with scope: namespace=prod-inference, role=namespace-admin, duration=30m, reason=INC-2026-1223 debugging KV OOM. When you do that reply here with the JIT id and we'll expedite. We will only allow exec/logs; no cluster-admin.

alex: Done — JIT request created JIT-8893. Note in the form that session will be recorded and logs to s3://redwood-logs/INC-2026-1223/.

secops-bot: JIT request JIT-8893 created for alex, scope=namespace-admin@prod-inference, expires in 30m. Audit event queued (audit-id: AUD-55502).

maria: Reviewed JIT-8893 and approved for 30m with condition: secops will validate session recording post-run, and any changed manifests require a separate approval. Alex, please ack you will not perform `kubectl apply` or touch secrets.

alex: Ack — no applies, no secret access. Will only exec, collect logs, and upload. Starting at 14:32 UTC. Will paste recording + S3 path when done. Thanks. :thumbsup:

maria: Noted — added audit note under INC-2026-1223. If you find a config change needed, open an RFC or ping infra for a proper rollout.

secops-bot: Temporary binding applied: rb-binding-1876543210-user-alex -> namespace=prod-inference, expires=1876545010 (30m). Audit link: https://audit.internal/redwood/AUD-55502

alex: Confirmed I can exec into `infer-worker-0`. Pulling logs now.
